data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by transient API failures (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) in the Qwen model, which prevented it from completing the audit for 3 out of 4 files. Deepseek successfully audited all files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO, PKGBUILD, and wayrdp.service due to HTTP 400 API errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors so that a single model's failure doesn't force an inconclusive package verdict if other models succeed.
Ensure the orchestrator aggregates successful file reviews across models to fill coverage gaps caused by individual model API failures.
